divergence.method: Presentation only. Outlier verdict: mean log-odds gaps over win/top 10/top 20; two sources agree within 0.15, the odd one out is 1.8x further from both. Data Golf check: logit(DG chance) on DG skill across the field; flag when the stated skill misses the odds-implied one by max(0.25, 1.5 x residual sd). Edge split: the price peers' median edge (else the field mean) + the ridge-explained component part beyond theirs + the unexplained rest. Peers: the 6 players with the nearest sportsbook win chance.

finish.calibration_note: exact tapes ranked with random tie-break vs the run's probabilities (dead-heat rules differ slightly)

edge_model.note: edge_sg = (model - market) in strokes per round via the model's own logit slope per market. attribution = ridge share of that gap loading on each field-relative component: a statistical attribution, not causal
